# ezCORE v0.2.0 — on-demand cores (hybrid delivery) + ROM import hardening

This release slims the package: the three desktop giants — `pointclick`
(ScummVM, ~170 MB), `dreamarc` (flycast, ~39 MB) and `powercube`
(dolphin, ~27 MB) — are now fetched **on demand** from this release's
assets and sha256-verified against the catalog pin before they ever run;
everything else stays bundled, iOS still never downloads (App Review
2.5.2/4.7), and the app never compiles cores on your device. ROM import
gained per-core validation and the managed-ROMs-folder dialogue. Biggest
caveat: this tag was produced on a Linux host — **macOS, Windows and iOS
binaries are not built and not verified here**.

## What's in this build

| Platform | Artifact | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x64 app | `ezcore-0.2.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` (attached) | Built by `scripts/release.sh` through every gate; **11 bundled cores — the 3 giants excluded by delivery**; `ldd` clean, RUNPATH `$ORIGIN/lib` |
| Android arm64 | `ezcore-0.2.0-android-arm64.apk` (attached) | arm64-v8a, built at this tag — app + Flutter engine only; **Android runtime/cores were not built on this host: on-device boot not verified** |
| Linux x64 cores | `pointclick_libretro-linux-x64.so`, `dreamarc_libretro-linux-x64.so`, `powercube_libretro-linux-x64.so` (attached) | On-demand core assets; sha256 pins in `cores/catalog.json` |
| macOS arm64 / Windows / iOS | — | **not built on this host — not verified** |

- Delivery: every core bundled on desktop **except the three giants**
  above (`delivery: download`, ADR-013). Android keeps its bundled tier;
  iOS unchanged (bundled/absent only).
- The app reads `cores/release.json` (tag `v0.2.0`) and offers
  **Download** in the Core Manager for cores the package doesn't carry.
- Verification level: full unit + policy gates green locally —
  `flutter analyze` clean, `flutter test` 354 passed / 15 skipped /
  0 failed, license/manifest/pin/content scans pass. Platform coverage
  remains `docs/MATRIX.md`.

## Known limitations

- macOS/Windows/iOS: **not built, not verified** — no binaries for them
  in this release.
- macOS-arm64 and Windows core assets for the three giants are listed in
  `cores/release.json` but **not uploaded yet** (they upload with their
  platform builds); on those platforms the app reports
  "not published for `<platform>` yet" instead of guessing.
- Android pointclick asset is not published yet (bundled tier, no
  Android download asset produced).
- The attached Android APK contains **no emulator-core binaries** on
  this build (they were produced on macOS for v0.1.1, not rebuilt here).

## Verifying your download

SHA-256 of every binary asset on this release (also shipped as
`SHA256SUMS.txt` attached; core pins are also in `cores/catalog.json`):

```
f59f7524226e269d2acf3ac8c673d8e8d7e46973bd7d2c312a95682c4132133c  ezcore-0.2.0-linux-x64.tar.gz
a13ee7bebe476258d34676364f9a4fcec993f19b72cb140168dac1a1aeb7dfb3  ezcore-0.2.0-android-arm64.apk
105aa4fefdc98b5875274f44aafa3a068ebdc27bef7a6ef3b24a0721baff03a1  pointclick_libretro-linux-x64.so
0407302467a879e79d06fb023ad98b165181b022622ba6c663171df0d5786c51  dreamarc_libretro-linux-x64.so
932183e20d222d914850fa3c081dcd34c6d2acbde4a418a3dc1455545646c81e  powercube_libretro-linux-x64.so
```

The app verifies the core assets automatically before staging — a
mismatch deletes the download and refuses installation.
